description: record-swap.mjs's CLI-entrypoint self-invocation guard uses `import.meta.url.endsWith(process.argv[1].split("/").pop())` -- a basename-suffix match -- whereas every other new/touched module in this feature (parse-pass.mjs, resolve-identity.mjs, record.mjs) uses the stronger, standard `path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` idiom already established in this codebase.
impact: In every actual call site in this feature (run.sh always invokes it via an absolute path computed from `$(cd ... && pwd)`) the weaker check is functionally correct, and it does not misfire during `node --test` imports of record-swap.test.mjs (verified statically: process.argv[1] during a test run is the test file's own path, whose basename can never equal 'record-swap.mjs'). This is a cosmetic inconsistency with the codebase's own established idiom, not a demonstrated functional defect. Non-blocking.
